thread.title: How Alibaba Can Combine the Best of Amazon, Microsoft and Apple

author: Teresa Rivas
title: How Alibaba Can Combine the Best of Amazon, Microsoft and Apple
text:
Alibaba Group (BABA) shares had a great 2017 , and plenty of analysts are upbeat about its prospects this year--and think it may one day sport a trillion-dollar market cap .
Illustration: Getty Images Oppenheimer's Jason Helfstein and his team are firmly in the bullish camp: They reiterated an Outperform rating and $220 price target on the shares Wednesday, as they see multiple growth catalysts ahead for both its massive ecommerce and growing cloud-based AI businesses.
Helfstein says that he's optimistic about Alibaba's dominant position in ecommerce: The company has s 488 million active consumers, who spend an average of $1,223 a year. But he's also encouraged by it's "new retail" strategy, as it ramps up its business-to-business efforts and streamlines distribution.
On the cloud side of the business, Helfstein forecasts Ali Cloud's 2019 revenues will reach the size of Amazon's (AMZN) AWS's in 2014 and Microsoft (MSFT) Azure's in 2017. And he likes the Alibaba ecosystem, which, much like Apple (AAPL), comes with plenty of barriers to entry.
Alibaba is up 0.8% to $193.82 this afternoon. The stock is up more than 12% year to date, and has gained 88.6% in the past year.
The Technology Select Sector SPDR ETF (XLK) is down 0.6% today.
